description_en: You can invoke ListSkillGroups to obtain the list of skill groups under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListSkillGroups获取指定实例下的技能组列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-skill-groups --instance-id ccc-test --search-pattern '测试技能组' --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --media-type Audio --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSkillGroups

parameters.description_en: Performs fuzzy matching based on the skill group name or display name. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 根据技能组名称或技能组展示名进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
